git.command: ( m=$(grep -v "^#" "$1" | grep -m1 .); case "$m" in Merge\ *|Revert\ \"*|fixup!\ *|squash!\ *|amend!\ *) exit 0;; esac; printf "%s\n" "$m" | grep -Eq "^(feat|fix|docs|chore|test|refactor|perf|ci|build|revert|release|style)(\([a-z0-9._/,-]+\))?!?: [a-z0-9]" || { printf "commit-msg: subject must be \"type(scope): lowercase description\" (types: feat fix docs chore test refactor perf ci build revert release style). Got: %s\n" "$m" >&2; exit 1; } ) || exit 1
